$comment: Every string a component writes itself, with the prop that replaces it and its Turkish default. A caller in another register or language passes the prop; nothing here is translated in place. Where a default is a template, {name} is filled by the component, numbers and dates through Intl in the page locale. prop null = a fixed string the component always writes. Defaults that come from another content file name it: change that file first, then the component. Rules: MDS-VOICE-01, MDS-VOICE-02, MDS-NUM-01, MDS-A11Y-04.

fields.prop: the prop that replaces the string; null = not replaceable
fields.default: the Turkish default the component writes; null = none, the caller must pass one
fields.note: where the string appears and what to know before changing it
